vu-2S4i.title: Landscape: dense tropical forest
vu-2S4i.summary: A tropical island chain, with a big part of the coverage in dense tropical forest.

vu-8ppR.title: Landmark: volcano trekker
vu-8ppR.summary: A unique trekker at the volcano in the middle of the island.

vu-BJP0.title: Coverage: Pacific island nation
vu-BJP0.summary: An island nation in the Pacific, northeast of Brisbane, between the Solomon Islands, New Caledonia and Fiji.

vu-Bssm.title: Coverage: Gen 3 trekker
vu-Bssm.summary: All coverage is the older Gen 3 trekker, carried on foot (blurrier, softer colours).

vu-DTRR.title: Houses: thatched huts, dark soil
vu-DTRR.summary: The only village with coverage on the island has small thatched huts and dark soil.

vu-G1Ko.title: Landscape: dark volcanic soil
vu-G1Ko.summary: The coverage is on a volcanic island, so you often see dark volcanic soil.

vu-HJp5.title: Coverage: only one island has coverage
vu-HJp5.summary: Of 13 main islands, only one has coverage. Find it by the Port Vato label on the map, north of the capital.

vu-ees3.title: Plants: jungle with ferns, red cap man
vu-ees3.summary: Tropical plants and lots of ferns in a jungle further east. A man in a red cap is seen with the trekker.

vu-g0KZ.title: Landscape: black sand beach
vu-g0KZ.summary: A black sand beach on the east side of the island.

vu-pVls.title: Landscape: plateau, brown soil, patchy grass
vu-pVls.summary: A distinct plateau with dark brown soil and patchy grass, east of the volcano.

vu-wjW2.title: Road: dirt road, tire tracks, purple soil
vu-wjW2.summary: A dirt road with tire tracks and slightly purple soil, east of the beach.
